verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer site names a CLI alongside REST and MCP as an official access surface ('REST, CLI, and MCP'), so a first-party CLI is claimed. Beyond that single heading there is no documentation of its commands, installation, auth flow, or agent-oriented behavior. missing for 10: CLI installation and command reference, evidence of AI-native/agent workflows via the CLI, any hands-on or independent corroboration that the CLI exists and works.
